description: This source file defines the MailMessageSender class responsible for sending email messages within the OpenMRS platform. It implements the MessageSender interface, provides methods to create and send MIME email messages, handles attachments, and manages the JavaMail session.

classes.name: MailMessageSender
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing and sending email messages using JavaMail within the OpenMRS platform. It manages the mail session, formats messages, handles attachments, and logs errors during sending.

methods.description: Creates a MimeMultipart object to include message content and attachments if present.
